BEFORE YOU SETTLE IN

A few answers,
nice and simple.

When can I play?

Tomesi Garden is coming soon to iPhone and iPad. The download link will appear here as soon as it’s available.

Will there be ads?

No. Not before a game, not after a win. The garden stays a peaceful place.

Do I need a connection or an account?

The games and garden work offline, with no account needed. An internet connection is required to download the app and make or restore an App Store purchase.

How do I get objects and outfits?

Playing earns you petals to spend in the garden shop on decorations, companions, outfits and card designs.

Can I arrange the garden freely?

Yes. Move your objects into suitable spaces: the ground, water or veranda. The inventory shows where each item can go. Plants, tea sets and little companions can all find a place in front of the house.

Can I reduce the animations?

Yes, the game offers a reduced-motion mode. On this site, the Pause button stops animations; your device’s preference is also respected.
